events.title: Ipsos shares plunge 13% after Q1 revenue miss on Americas slump
events.body: Investing.com -- Ipsos (EPA:ISOS) reported first-quarter 2026 revenue below analyst estimates on Thursday, with organic sales falling 1.4% as weakness in the Americas overshadowed an improving order book, sending shares down 13% on Friday.
